flags.title: The Library's Exams tab becomes Dates; each date has a kind, and one registry says which tools a kind offers; study plan becomes prep plan
flags.why: Matt approved (ev-build channel 2026-11-06): the product must not read as exam-only. The user-facing name is Dates, not Exams or Deadlines (a talk, trip or renewal is a date but not a deadline). Every date is a goals row with a kind (domain/goal already stores kind as data); exam is one kind. One registry in domain/ (one home) maps each kind to the tools it offers. Today it has one entry: kind exam offers the study plan and its weak-spot links. Screens and jobs ask the registry, never check for exams by name, so a new kind or tool later is one registry entry, not a new code path. Built inside B-1038 (no new task ids, D-497). Build no new kinds or tools now. A date's name may still say Exam 3. The Library tab id and label exams/Exams become dates/Dates (areas/library, its tests and links that open the tab), and design/mockup.html names the tab Dates in the same change. Internal exam and examsByCourse names in areas and server go when B-1038 drops the old exam reads. Wording (Matt 2026-11-06): the user-facing name "study plan" becomes "prep plan" everywhere he reads it (UI labels, button text, toasts, E.V.'s messages, design/mockup.html); code identifiers follow only where B-1038 touches them, with no separate rename sweep. Word rule: "study" stays only as a verb for working through a set or practice ("Study this set"); names of things stay general (Dates, Plan, Prep plan, Sets, Notes), with no "study" in them. Prep plans for other date kinds come after the task freeze (docs/parked.md).
flags.source: Matt, ev-build channel 2026-11-06; shape by the build manager
